st.title: Translate
st.placeholder: Paste or type text to translate, Ctrl + Enter to translate
st.writeInputHint: Write-back replaces everything in the chat input, including attached files and mentions
st.resultStale: The input changed, this translation is out of date
st.writeFail: Write-back failed, the chat input was left unchanged
st.idleHint: Translates between 19 languages including Chinese, English and Japanese.
st.textTooLong: Text is longer than {{max}} characters and was cut off
st.autoTranslateTooLong: Texts over {{max}} characters are not translated automatically, click Translate to start
st.settings.engineHint: Microsoft and Google use free public endpoints and need no key; the other engines require your own API key.
st.settings.fallback: Fall back to a free engine when the primary engine fails
st.settings.fallbackHint: Switches to the free public endpoint when the selected engine fails
st.settings.promptPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the built-in translation prompt
st.settings.autoTranslateHint: Off = translate with the Translate button
st.settings.selectionButton: Show a floating translate button for selected chat text
st.settings.selectionButtonHint: Pops up next to the text you select in a chat
st.settings.messageButton: Show a translate button in the AI reply action bar
st.settings.messageButtonHint: Adds a translate entry to every AI reply
st.settings.autoFill: Prefill the panel with the selected text
st.settings.autoFillHint: Brings in the text selected right now
st.settings.languagesHint: With the auto target, Chinese becomes English and other languages become the UI language.
st.settings.resetConfirm: Click Restore defaults again to clear your saved API keys
st.settings.deeplHint: A DeepL key ending with a colon means the free plan (formatted like xxxx:fx).
st.settings.baiduHint: Create a general text translation app on the Baidu Translate Open Platform to get the APP ID and key; usage follows that account's free quota.
st.settings.openaiHint: Any service compatible with /chat/completions works; enter the /v1 base URL or the full endpoint.
st.error.NETWORK: Network request failed, check your network or proxy
st.error.HTTP.tooLong: The request URL was too long (HTTP {{status}}): this chunk exceeds the proxy or gateway URL limit. Shorten the text or switch engines
st.error.HTTP.body: The server did not return JSON (HTTP {{status}}): likely a proxy block page, a gateway error page, or a bot challenge
st.error.HTTP.ua: Microsoft rejected this client (HTTP {{status}}): usually a proxy rewriting the request or a tightened endpoint. Retry without the proxy, or switch engines
st.error.AUTH: Authentication failed, check the API key
st.error.AUTH.balance: The Baidu Translate account is out of balance (error code {{code}}). Top up and try again
st.error.RATE: Too many requests (HTTP {{status}}), try again later
st.error.RATE.api: Baidu returned error code {{code}}: too many requests, try again later
st.error.NETWORK.proxy: Network request failed: the proxy is unreachable
st.error.NETWORK.tls: Network request failed: the TLS handshake was interrupted
st.error.NETWORK.dns: Network request failed: the domain could not be resolved
st.error.NETWORK.timeout: Network request failed: the request timed out
st.error.NETWORK.offline: Network request failed: the network is offline
st.error.NETWORK.refused: Network request failed: the connection was refused
st.error.hint.bing: The Microsoft endpoint is often blocked by proxies (TLS handshake interrupted); turn off the system or Snow App proxy and retry, or switch to Google.
st.error.hint.network: Check your network and proxy settings, then retry.
st.error.hint.proxy: The proxy is not responding; make sure it is running, or turn it off and retry.
st.error.hint.tls: The proxy interrupted the TLS handshake; switch proxy node or let this domain connect directly.
st.error.hint.dns: The domain did not resolve; check DNS and the proxy routing rules.
st.error.hint.timeout: The request timed out; check network quality or proxy latency and retry.
st.error.hint.offline: The system network is unavailable; reconnect and retry.
st.error.hint.refused: The connection was refused or closed early; retry later, or switch proxy.
st.error.hint.auth: Make sure the API key is correct, not expired, and matches the selected plan.
st.error.hint.balance: Top up the Baidu Translate account in the Baidu console, or switch to a free engine such as Microsoft or Google.
st.error.hint.rate: Try again later, or lower the auto-translate frequency.
st.error.hint.tooLong: A proxy or gateway limited the URL length; connect directly without the proxy, or switch to an engine that sends POST (Bing, Baidu).
st.error.hint.body: This is not a local network failure; try another engine, or check whether a proxy or gateway rewrote the response.
st.error.hint.ua: Turn off the system or Snow App proxy and retry; if it still fails, the endpoint no longer accepts a browser UA. Switch to Google or another engine.
